title: QuickTest Builder: no code, just steps. Press CH+, check the picture moves
description:
QuickTest Builder: no code, just steps.

Pick a device, take control, and list what should happen: go to live, press CH+, check the picture moves. Run it: the box zaps, the backend checks the new channel plays, and the test passes in about 9 seconds. The report is the same as for any other test: before and after, each step, the video.
